methods.label: G0: original boundary GNNM
methods.rule: Shared native body, original signed input factors and neutral remaining factors; mean own native risk F and mean raw logits.

methods.label: Private half-pool credit
methods.rule: Shared gradient F; private gradient .5F+.5L_mean. One native optimizer transition.

methods.label: Fixed positive bootstrap responsibility
methods.rule: Preserve predecessor fixed Exp weights and native class/group normalization. Shared F; private weighted W.

methods.label: Earlier node within-route SupCon
methods.rule: Exact predecessor node within-route SupCon recipe; do not alias it to the new cross-route geometry.

methods.label: Class alignment
methods.rule: All-block F+.05A, temperature .2. Class-balanced anchors/denominator; same-class existing route preheads. Full native task population retained.

methods.label: Class alignment + conditional variance
methods.rule: Same alignment plus conditional within-route, within-class variance floor .5/sqrt(width); coefficient .05 on the declared combined auxiliary.

methods.label: Link same-query cosine
methods.rule: Shared F; private F+.05A. Existing authenticated query pairs, no task-negative invention, same endpoint-eligible anchors as contrast controls.

methods.label: Link same-query global contrast
methods.rule: Shared F; private F+.05InfoNCE, temperature .2. Same-query positive; same-relation opposite source-label alternatives; endpoint-matched counts/support.

methods.label: Link same-query endpoint contrast
methods.rule: Same rule and source query reductions as global, but alternatives share an endpoint. Max1024 anchors and16 alternatives; disclose zero support.

methods.label: Structural class-quartile responsibility
methods.rule: TRAIN classwise incoming-degree/atom-count fractional quartiles, w=.5+2q. Shared F; private W. Preserve native reductions, no minibatch renormalization.

methods.label: Permuted quartile control
methods.rule: One whole-vector within-class permutation of the exact quartile weight table, fit seed+7030031, no redraw; same block updates.

methods.label: Link endpoint responsibility v2
methods.rule: Corrected v2 symmetric positive endpoint field; shared F/private W; exact native group normalization. Normalized marginals need not match query control.

methods.label: Link matched query responsibility v2
methods.rule: Corrected v2 query field: two Exp draws for nonloops, one for loops, matching endpoint raw marginal; group normalization retained.

methods.label: Common context-affinity target
methods.rule: All-block F+.05A; existing prehead donor distribution at temperature .2 learns .5q_A+.5q_B for every route. TRAIN-only target labels; same donor support/work as split.

methods.label: Split context-affinity targets
methods.rule: Same loss/donors/budget as common. Routes0/1 use q_A, routes2/3 q_B. No extra inference input, head, teacher or VALID target.

methods.label: BE + private input residual
methods.rule: BE plus h+U_m GELU(V_m h) at the declared encoded input; rank=min(8,width), zero U and fixed-law orthonormal V frames; one shared native body.

methods.label: Four-route input residual without BE
methods.rule: Four private residual routes around one shared native body, BE hooks/banks removed before training; same native constructor and optimizer semantics.

methods.label: Mean aggregation under global J
methods.rule: All-block J=.5F+.5L_actual. Uniform mean, zero added parameters; alias of predecessor global half-pool, one fit only.

methods.label: Learned global aggregation under J
methods.rule: Same J, four TRAIN-learned biases, weights .05+.8softmax(score), exact uniform start.

methods.label: Conditional aggregation under J
methods.rule: Same J,20 parameters, detached entropy confidence/JS descriptors, hidden4 GELU scorer and route biases; same positive weight floor/uniform start.

methods.label: Geometry × input correction
methods.rule: Combine BE input residual with labelled alignment+variance or link endpoint contrast, using each task's exact preceding gradient rule; no coefficient search.

methods.label: Responsibility × private pool credit
methods.rule: Shared F; private .5W_structured+.5L_mean. Compare G0, structured W and private half-pool to complete the2x2.

methods.label: Input correction × mean J
methods.rule: BE input residual with all-block .5F+.5L_mean; same adapter initialization/site and J as its ingredient controls.

methods.label: Input correction × conditional J
methods.rule: BE input residual plus conditional20-parameter aggregator, all-block .5F+.5L_actual; compare same selected bank under actual gate and mean.

methods.label: Private native BN state
methods.rule: Prospective route-private BN running buffers/counters; affine and native weights shared, original BN operators/batches. No BN introduced into BN-free models.

not_included: C7 joint-pattern: native observed target/capture not yet frozen
probabilistic factors/flow matching: no defensible frozen distribution/target yet
private-BN x adapter: may be a later explicit study, no implicit Cartesian grid
